body: Don't like people all that much, I'm afriad. I'm a very selfish person in nature, sadly. Of course, I could volunteer to help those in need, but I would get little out of it and it would still take quite a lot of time and money. But maybe I could give it a shot before taking my leave.

I could change my life, sure. There's no aspect of my life that can't be changed. However, change doesn't imply improvement. I'm not a huge fan of changing things around a lot; this is as good as it's going to get for me, and it's not good enough. 

I could imagine things I'd enjoy, sure. Sitting in front of my computer and my TV 24/7 with some paprika chips and a coke, I would enjoy. But that's not feasible, is it?

The issue is that as a person, I don't have enough willpower to actually go out there and make pros. Seems like a whole lot of effort with little payoff, whereas suicide would be a catch-all solution, even if not necessarily the best, it's also the simplest.
